description: This file handles outbound message delivery in a chat system, including creating channel handlers, normalizing payloads, managing delivery queues, and executing message sending with hooks and media support.

methods.name: loadTranscriptRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the transcript runtime module, caching the promise.

methods.name: loadChannelBootstrapRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the channel bootstrap runtime module, caching the promise.

methods.name: createChannelHandler
methods.description: Creates a channel handler by loading the outbound adapter and wrapping it with plugin logic.

methods.name: createPluginHandler
methods.description: Wraps an outbound adapter with additional logic for sanitization, normalization, and sending.

methods.name: createChannelOutboundContextBase
methods.description: Builds the base context object for outbound channel communication.

methods.name: collectPayloadMediaSources
methods.description: Extracts media URLs from reply payloads for media access.

methods.name: normalizeEmptyPayloadForDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes payloads with empty or whitespace-only text.

methods.name: normalizePayloadsForChannelDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes and sanitizes reply payloads for channel delivery.

methods.name: buildPayloadSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object of the payload for sending and hooks.

methods.name: createMessageSentEmitter
methods.description: Creates functions to emit message sent events to hooks and internal systems.

methods.name: applyMessageSendingHook
methods.description: Runs message sending hooks that can modify or cancel message payloads.

methods.name: deliverOutboundPayloads
methods.description: Main function to deliver multiple reply payloads, managing queue, hooks, and media.

methods.name: deliverOutboundPayloadsCore
methods.description: Performs the core logic of delivering payloads, including chunking, media handling, and hooks.
